entries.title: I Thessalonians 3:1
segments: Therefore when we could no longer endure, we were pleased to be left at Athens alone.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 3:2
segments: And we sent Timothy, our brother and minister of God, and our fellow laborer in the gospel of Christ, to establish you and to comfort you concerning your faith,

entries.title: I Thessalonians 3:3
segments: so that no one should be drawn aside by these afflictions. For you yourselves know that we are appointed to them.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 3:4
segments: For truly, when we were with you, we told you before that we were going to suffer affliction, as it also happened, even you know.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 3:5
segments: For this cause, when I could no longer endure, I also sent to know your faith, lest by some means the tempter may have tempted you and our labor may have been in vain.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 3:6
segments: But now when Timothy came from you to us and brought us good news [of] your faith and love, and that you have good remembrance of us always, desiring to see us (as we also you),

entries.title: I Thessalonians 3:7
segments: then, my brothers, we were comforted over you, through your faith, even in all our affliction and needs;

entries.title: I Thessalonians 3:8
segments: for now we live, if you stand fast in [the] Lord.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 3:9
segments: For what thanks can we render to God again for you, for all the joy [with] which we rejoice for your sakes before our God,

entries.title: I Thessalonians 3:10
segments: night and day praying exceedingly for [me] to see your face and to perfect the things lacking in your faith?

entries.title: I Thessalonians 3:11
segments: And may God Himself and our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ direct our way to you.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 3:12
segments: And may the Lord make you to increase and abound in love toward one another and toward all, even as we do toward you,

entries.title: I Thessalonians 3:13
segments: in order to establish your hearts blameless in holiness before God, even our Father, at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ with all His saints.
